messages.subject: Forced and not forced items
parts:
Hi everyone and Phil,

I created a sequantal test via mirtCAT and shiny. Phil's examples helped me a lot. Thanks for examples on wiki. I stuck in a problem. I want to use forced and not forced items in same session. I need item timer in some items but that time forced items are giong to be not forced items. Can I prevent this situation?

Thanks,

Levent

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Forced and not forced items
parts:
Seems like a reasonable request. I'll try to add a forced optional column to the df input to indicate which items should be taken as forced or not rather than the current global behaviour. Thanks for bringing this to my attention.

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Forced and not forced items
parts:
Features is available on the dev version now using the new form

df <- data.frame(..., Forced = TRUE)

so now the forced/not forced items can be specified on a per-item basis. Note that this deprecates the previous shinyGUI list approach to avoid conflicts.
 
Phil
